sections.heading: Sharing the road: first part — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: sharing the road: first part within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Pedestrians; Motorcycles; Bicycles; Sharing with large vehicles. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Every extracted passenger-driver duty concerning pedestrians, motorcycles, bicycles and large-vehicle limitations is represented. This teaches sharing with commercial vehicles rather than operating them. Bicycle-signal postures are not described in the selected text, so no posture is invented. The broad motorcycle stopping-distance comparison is source-qualified pending review.
